ABS reduces wheel lock under hard braking. Traction control limits excess drive-wheel slip. Surface grip and suspension response change with the road.
Online vehicle library ready. GLB works as a single file; for GLTF packs, select the model together with its BIN / texture files, or extract the pack and use IMPORT PACK FOLDER.
SOURCES: KENNEY CAR KIT · CC0 · COSMO LOW POLY CARS · ITCH.IO TWO-WHEEL PACK · SCOOTER + MOTORBIKE. Download the pack, then select its scooter/motorbike GLB with IMPORT GLB MODEL. The linked pack allows personal/commercial game use; do not redistribute its raw files.

OPEN ROADS · COMMUNITY RELEASE NOTES

What's new.

Updates and improvements shipped in OPEN ROADS.

v1.6.1 · MULTIPLAYER CONNECTION TEST & RELIABILITY — ONLINE FREE DRIVE

NOVEMBER 2026 · CURRENT RELEASE
  • Added private 6-character lobby codes with create and join flows.
  • Added room player lists, host ownership, map synchronization and shared Free Drive start.
  • Added live remote vehicle representations with smooth interpolation and player name labels.
  • Added a separate Colyseus Node.js server project supporting up to 8 drivers per room.
  • Race Mode remains visible as COMING SOON.
  • First multiplayer milestone uses server-validated, rate-limited vehicle pose relay; server-authoritative vehicle physics and vehicle-to-vehicle collision are future work.

v1.5.0 · ADVANCED DRIVING PHYSICS — PREVIOUS RELEASE

NOVEMBER 2026 · CURRENT RELEASE
  • Reworked four-wheel handling around front and rear tyre slip angles, cornering forces and yaw inertia.
  • Added asphalt, gravel and off-road grip profiles with surface-aware acceleration and braking.
  • Added ABS and traction-control toggles to the garage driving controls.
  • Improved handbrake breakaway, rear grip recovery, power oversteer and counter-steering.
  • Added pedal smoothing, speed-sensitive steering and more stable high-speed response.
  • Added visible wheel suspension travel and acceleration/braking weight transfer through chassis pitch and roll.
  • Preserved the existing two-wheeler handling branch, vehicle roster, City and Forest maps, cockpit view and audio.

v1.4.0 · MEGA CITY EXPANSION — PREVIOUS RELEASE

NOVEMBER 2026 · PREVIOUS RELEASE
  • Expanded the fixed City into a 10×10 grid containing 100 connected city blocks.
  • Added a downtown skyline, residential neighborhoods, commercial streets, civic landmarks, industrial areas and six landscaped parks.
  • Added a much larger connected road network with long avenues, side streets, sidewalks, curbs, lane markings and marked crossings.
  • Added 191 fixed building placements with textured facades, rooftops and varied low-poly architecture.
  • Added streetlights, traffic signals, district signs, bus stops, hydrants, bins, trees, planters and park details.
  • Embedded high-resolution facade and asphalt textures in the standalone HTML for local rendering.
  • Kept the separate fixed Forest map, garage, vehicle roster, chase and cockpit cameras, driving physics and audio.

v1.3.0 · CITY & FOREST MAPS — MAJOR UPDATE

NOVEMBER 2026 · PREVIOUS RELEASE
  • Replaced random world generation with two fixed, selectable maps: a standalone City and a separate Forest.
  • Added a flat urban world with a street grid, buildings, park, street furniture and a dedicated garage entrance.
  • Kept a fixed winding Forest route, gravel cut-through and ridge trail with dense trees, bushes and rocks.
  • Added map selection from the launch screen and in-game map menu.
  • Fixed first-person mode, garage placement and vehicle reset so they respect the selected map.

v1.2.0 · CITY EXPANSION — PREVIOUS RELEASE

NOVEMBER 2026 · PREVIOUS RELEASE
  • Added a new low-poly city district built from modular GLB street tiles and connected to the existing scenic road network.
  • Added residential homes, apartments, shops, offices and neighborhood services.
  • Added streetlights, traffic signals, crosswalks, bus stop, benches, bins, planters and stop signs.
  • Added a landscaped city park with trees and shrubs, plus a gently flattened city terrain zone.
  • Integrated the CC0 1.0 Low Poly City Kit with lightweight procedural fallbacks when a model cannot load.
  • Kept the existing garage, vehicle roster, chase and cockpit cameras, audio, physics and seeded scenic routes.

v1.1.9 · 3D STARTUP FIX & FIRST-PERSON DRIVING

NOVEMBER 2026 · CURRENT RELEASE
  • Corrected the first-person mode into vehicle driving, not a shooter.
  • Added a cockpit camera with driver eye position, dashboard, instrument cluster and steering wheel for cars.
  • Added a dedicated handlebar and compact gauge view for mopeds, scooters and dirt bikes.
  • Camera follows vehicle position, yaw, terrain pitch and body lean, with subtle speed-responsive cockpit movement.
  • Added START FIRST-PERSON DRIVE, which generates a fresh procedural road network before entering the cockpit.
  • Kept the existing chase camera, vehicle roster, garage, driving physics, map generator, sounds and controls.
  • Added three version-matched Three.js CDN fallback sources and delayed startup until the engine loader completes.
  • Added lower-overhead WebGL context settings with retry options and clearer startup diagnostics.
  • Added return-to-main-menu to the standard pause screen.

v1.1.6 · GARAGE REFRESH & COMMUNITY CAR KIT

NOVEMBER 2026 · CURRENT RELEASE
  • Redesigned garage collection cards with real model thumbnails, clearer vehicle classes, power labels and selected-state feedback.
  • Added Utility filter and expanded the vehicle roster with patrol sedan, taxi, classic sedan, concept racer, ambulance, courier van, flatbed carrier, fire response truck and city service truck.
  • Integrated additional Kenney Car Kit GLB models from the existing public CC0 asset library. The assets remain externally hosted rather than duplicated in the game ZIP.
  • Added a model-pack folder importer for multiple GLB files and GLTF files with their BIN / texture dependencies.
  • Improved vehicle count, category grouping, mobile card sizing and garage typography.

v1.1.5 · DIRT BIKE PACK

NOVEMBER 2026 · CURRENT RELEASE
  • Added two original motocross-inspired rides: MX 250 and MX 450.
  • Built-in detailed bike silhouettes with knobby tyres, front number plates, fenders, exposed frame shapes, forks, swingarm, engine casing and rider gear.
  • Added a dedicated DIRT BIKES garage filter and updated vehicle grouping.
  • Added arcade-style cornering lean, animated steering, wheel rotation and responsive suspension movement.
  • Added off-road dirt spray and a higher-pitched two-wheel engine audio profile.
  • Retained the v1.1.4 community interface, seeded map, garage, imports and existing vehicles.

v1.1.4 · COMMUNITY UI POLISH

NOVEMBER 2026 · CURRENT RELEASE
  • Reworked the launch screen with a clearer Free Drive entry point and community-build identity.
  • Consolidated secondary tools into a responsive More menu and added a keyboard-accessible quick guide.
  • Refined the driving HUD, garage panel, buttons, modals and mobile touch controls.
  • Improved keyboard focus, reduced-motion support, safe-area spacing and small-screen layout.
  • Preserved existing vehicle, audio, seeded world, asset-import, crash and Story Mode systems.

v1.1.3 · PROCEDURAL WORLD & ASSET PIPELINE

NOVEMBER 2026
  • Added seeded map generation with a main asphalt loop, connected forest cut-through and gravel ridge trail.
  • Added route-aware scenery placement: trees and rocks keep clear of road corridors and the garage spawn area.
  • Added MAP LAB with forest density, seed control and local GLB import for itch.io tree packs and road tiles.
  • Added four reusable low-poly fallback tree styles and improved roadside reflectors / route signs.
  • Added a dedicated CC0 scooter/moped engine loop with RPM and throttle pitch response.

v1.1.2 · ELECTRIC MOBILITY & GARAGE OVERHAUL

NOVEMBER 2026
  • Added three selectable electric rides: Electric Kick Scooter, Compact E-Scooter and Urban Electric Moped, each with a separate GLB model and handling profile.
  • Added a classic 150cc scooter profile with its own power, weight, gearing and handling values.
  • Electric vehicles now have battery percentage, estimated remaining range, regenerative braking and garage-pad charging.
  • Added a synthesized electric motor whine that rises with speed and throttle.
  • Garage now supports vehicle search and All / Cars / Petrol / Electric filters, with grouped vehicle categories.
  • Improved onboarding, vehicle cards and current release information.

v1.1.1 · MOPEDS & SCOOTERS

NOVEMBER 2026
  • Added selectable Retro Moped 50cc and Classic City Scooter with distinct engine, gearing, weight and speed profiles.
  • Added two-wheel vehicle handling, wheel animation, front-wheel steering and cornering lean.
  • Added local 3D fallback scooter geometry so the new vehicle slots remain playable if remote GLBs fail.
  • Added an itch.io free two-wheel asset pack link for importing its scooter and motorbike GLBs through the garage.

v1.1.0 · WRECK LOCK, CRASH AUDIO & WHEEL STEERING

NOVEMBER 2026
  • Destroyed vehicles are now fully immobilized: throttle, brake/reverse and steering cannot move the wreck.
  • Severe impacts stop the car immediately and keep it locked until reset/repair.
  • Added procedural crash sounds that scale from a light thud to a heavy metallic impact based on collision speed.
  • Corrected the front-wheel visual steering direction so tyres point the same way the car turns.
  • Reset/repair straightens the front wheels and restores the vehicle with the engine off.

v1.0.9 · CRASH SYSTEM & STEERING

NOVEMBER 2026
  • Added impact-based vehicle damage and crash feedback when hitting rocks and trees.
  • Severe impacts can disable the vehicle; reset position also repairs it.
  • Improved steering response and speed-sensitive steering for more predictable control.
  • Added adjustable steering sensitivity and stability assist in the garage.
  • Introduced a Story Mode tab marked COMING SOON with a campaign preview.

v1.0.9 · IGNITION & CHANGELOG

NOVEMBER 2026
  • Press R or use the ENGINE button to start and stop the engine.
  • New starter crank sound, visible startup vibration and engine idle/rev audio.
  • Throttle is disabled until the engine is running; the car coasts when switched off.
  • Added this in-game changelog panel.

v1.0.7 · DRIFT SMOKE & ROAD AUDIO

PREVIOUS RELEASE
  • Rear-wheel smoke responds to drift intensity and speed.
  • Dedicated asphalt rolling noise and separate off-road gravel audio.
  • Improved drift squeal and drift-entry sound effects.

v1.0.6 · VEHICLE AUDIO

PREVIOUS RELEASE
  • Engine, tyre, gravel and transmission audio layers.
  • Sound settings with independent volume controls.

v1.0.5 · DRIFTING & CREDITS

PREVIOUS RELEASE
  • Improved handbrake drift, counter-steering and grip recovery.
  • Added project credits for DEV: ALEX and RGB5.5 ULTRA CODE.
